notes.text: The live passage defines a surmarquage using the effectively marked edges and the components B+ of the written expression Sigma+\R cap Sigma+. It gives a map r′:B+→N, discusses r′(b) new rigidification vertices, and states that deleting the marked subset R′ of R1 recovers (X,Sigma,R). It also asserts determination up to unique isomorphism. This is an account of the page, not a verification of those assertions.

The source writes Sigma+\R cap Sigma+ without parentheses; the transcription supplies no grouping correction. The prose after l’opération qui sur chaque arête reaches r′(b) nouveaux sommets without a separately readable insertion of a governing verb. No such word has been supplied.

The two-level margin and the opening cancelled draft retain several unresolved readings. The (ouverte) insertion has a genuine uncertainty of cancellation scope; the source strike crosses its ending and then all of qui. The final phrase concerning unique isomorphism is kept in the baseline order, and the raised soit tuple is placed before the dash.

Every material departure has a viewed evidence crop. Original and two prepared halves were viewed once. The first attempt to return five existing crops produced tool-output truncation; those files were subsequently viewed in smaller calls. margin_nb initially clipped the right part of the first line; the still-open passage received the fuller margin_nb_full crop, which is the cited evidence. No OCR, outside page, web lookup or TeX compilation was used.

The framed old item may be A) or 4); both alternatives remain. The page has the author’s upper number 12 and lower handwritten number 55. These and every numeric index or exponent fall within the original-image audit boxes.
